svg.title: Hatchery technician — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as hatchery technician, wearing an apron and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: A small fish swims below the waterline of a long rectangular tank under a separate overhead inlet pipe. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap.
